recap.back_html: Gold from existing systems: Mirroring. Bronze ingestion: Copy job. Low-latency events: Eventstream.
Orchestration: ordering, branching, loops, retries and alerts across activities.
Spark for code-first, large-volume engineering. Dataflow Gen2 for low-code Power Query authors.
Copy activity needs hand-built state. Copy job tracks the last successful run itself.

lessons.takeaway_html: Mirroring for curated databases, Copy job for bronze, Eventstream for events, Spark or Dataflow Gen2 for transformation, and pipelines to orchestrate.
